parsed.explanation: The asserted lattice dichotomy is unjustified because Xiang’s cuts may occur at arbitrary real positions, so the resulting piece lengths and D-values need not lie on any dyadic unit lattice. Moreover, reverse triangle gives only D(P∪Q)≥|D(P)−D(Q)|; without a proved separation of D(P) and D(Q), this may be below 1. The surrounding dummy-piece discussion, low-n checks, and stronger-claim remark do not supply an all-n proof. Establishing L3.3 requires a substantive universal pairing/tree, majorization, or valid induction lemma.
